current_difficulty_reason: Miyaoka extension and Moishezon projectivity do not transfer the universal-cover Kahler form to the modified ball on their own. Proposition2.4 constructs compatible holomorphic embeddings by iterating the Kato fundamental domains and proving that they exhaust the punctured modified ball. Lemma10.2 then glues the pulled-back form to a Fubini–Study multiple through a controlled regularized maximum, providing the new construction needed before the final projectivity theorem applies.
